name: Seoul Trip
overview: On the first day of my trip to Seoul, I chased down a man I mistook for a pickpocket, only to end up spending the night with him. To my horror, I later found my wallet tucked safely in my bag—and discovered he was actually waiting for an "outcall service." The moment I’m forced to pay my debt with my body instead of cash, a disastrous misunderstanding spirals into a dangerous Seoul affair.
